terra.problem: The passage does not say David had a sleepless night. It also notes when kings went to war but does not explicitly say David was obligated to go.
The paragraph largely repeats the sequence of David’s cover-up rather than developing its lesson. The claim that sin hides best behind a busy schedule is not supported by the passage.
The passage does not say David hid his actions from the whole city, the army, or Joab’s messenger. ‘Keep your ovens ready’ is unclear and unrelated to the passage’s lesson.
